import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/incidents/alerts?incident_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bincident_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Binjury_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Brecipient_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bseverity_level_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Btriggered_by_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bfiling_type_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
